ICO trade cars that show up on our lot YMM join test

What this tests When a KBB ICO asks us to value their car, does that same year/make/model later appear in VinSolutions inventory (Used/CPO)? This is an acquired-metal / lot-fit signal, not proof the same person bought or that we bought that exact car from that lead. Join is year/make/model on Used+CPO inventory — not a person-level proof. Common trades can false-match. 'Arrived after ICO' means Inv Created Date is on/after the ICO open (minus 1 day). Active lot hit = that YMM is on the lot now.

Source detail

Unique workable opportunities · Aug 25 – Sep 23, 2026 · de-duped · same funnel window · Close = sold ÷ opps · Response = average adjusted minutes (over 4 hours dropped from average)
What this means Drill-down on where demand came from — owned website vs Autotrader/KBB vs other portals vs OEM partner, then phone and walk-in. High volume + low close often means a source quality issue. Whether the team worked those leads fast belongs on the Handling tab. Dealer website includes Motive, store-domain forms/chat, and Carcode. KBB ICO cash offers are acquisition (not retail) — see Wholesale & acquisition. Autotrader/KBB is one 3rd party with many of their own channels. Response sits next to close so you can see whether slow first touch lines up with weak conversion. * on response = half or more timed values are 0 (common on phone/walk-in — weak signal).

Organized as a sales funnel: website traffic → inventory health (active lot) → demand shape (VOI / trades) → CRM opportunities (site + 3rd party → internet/phone/walk-in) → handling quality (including how the team tries to reach customers) → salesperson execution. Unique opportunities after de-dupe (VIN/stock within 7 days, or same salesperson + day + vehicle). Internet + phone + walk-in on the same shopper counts as one. Headline contact rate is internet leads only (workable, de-duped, any real attempt). Internet speed uses CRM adjusted response time on internet leads only. Inventory panel uses VinSolutions live-lot units when an inventory export is present. Lead data: VinSolutions. ICO trade cars that show up on our lot YMM join test

What this tests When a KBB ICO asks us to value their car, does that same year/make/model later appear in VinSolutions inventory (Used/CPO)? This is an acquired-metal / lot-fit signal, not proof the same person bought or that we bought that exact car from that lead. Join is year/make/model on Used+CPO inventory — not a person-level proof. Common trades can false-match. 'Arrived after ICO' means Inv Created Date is on/after the ICO open (minus 1 day). Active lot hit = that YMM is on the lot now.

Source detail

Unique workable opportunities · Jul 26 – Sep 23, 2026 · de-duped · same funnel window · Close = sold ÷ opps · Response = average adjusted minutes (over 4 hours dropped from average)
What this means Drill-down on where demand came from — owned website vs Autotrader/KBB vs other portals vs OEM partner, then phone and walk-in. High volume + low close often means a source quality issue. Whether the team worked those leads fast belongs on the Handling tab. Dealer website includes Motive, store-domain forms/chat, and Carcode. KBB ICO cash offers are acquisition (not retail) — see Wholesale & acquisition. Autotrader/KBB is one 3rd party with many of their own channels. Response sits next to close so you can see whether slow first touch lines up with weak conversion. * on response = half or more timed values are 0 (common on phone/walk-in — weak signal).

How well are we taking care of the leads?
Speed and contact coverage when the CRM export includes them; how the team tries to reach customers (phone / email / text); retail close and open pipeline. Source mix lives on the Leads tab.

Pertinent handling numbers

Date range: Jul 26 – Sep 23, 2026 (vs prior 60 days May 27 – Jul 25, 2026)
What this section is Handling grades for rolling 60 on unique opportunities after de-dupe. Bad CRM leads are excluded. Contact and speed grades appear only when the CRM export includes attempt fields.
Handling color legend
GoodKPI is in the healthy band for that metric
WatchKPI is middling — keep an eye on it
ProblemKPI is below the store target band
Per-card rulesInternet contact ≥90% good / <75% problem · response goal ≤15 min (after 15 = not good; ≥25% over 30 = problem even if median looks ok) · retail close ≥8% good / <5% problem · untouched 0 good
1) Internet contact rate
Internet leads only · workable unique opportunities · Jul 26 – Sep 23, 2026

99.8%

What this means Of internet unique opportunities (de-duped, excluding Bad), how many show a real work attempt — first contact attempt, phone/email/text, customer contact, or CRM contacted flag? Phone-ups and walk-ins are not in this grade — those are almost always “contacted” by nature and inflate the number. Higher is better. About 90%+ is good. Under 75% is a problem.

10 min

Store goal: first internet response in ≤15 minutes. After 15 min = not good. Over 30 min = missed goal.
≤15 min · on goal236 (60.8%)

Speed problem — missed goal: 99 timed internet leads (25.5%) took over 30 minutes. Store goal is first response in ≤15 minutes. 152 (39.2%) were after 15 min — that is not good. Do not let the median hide this bucket.
What this means Internet only, using VinSolutions adjusted response time when the export includes it. Phone-ups and walk-ins are not mixed in — they often show as 0 minutes and fake a fast store. Goal is ≤15 minutes. Any first response after 15 min is not good. The red over 30 min bucket is the problem list — read it even when the median looks okay. Bands: ≤15 on goal · 16–30 late · over 30 missed goal.

ICO trade cars that show up on our lot YMM join test

What this tests When a KBB ICO asks us to value their car, does that same year/make/model later appear in VinSolutions inventory (Used/CPO)? This is an acquired-metal / lot-fit signal, not proof the same person bought or that we bought that exact car from that lead. Join is year/make/model on Used+CPO inventory — not a person-level proof. Common trades can false-match. 'Arrived after ICO' means Inv Created Date is on/after the ICO open (minus 1 day). Active lot hit = that YMM is on the lot now.

Stage 4 · Lead handling quality
How well are we taking care of the leads?
Speed and contact coverage when the CRM export includes them; how the team tries to reach customers (phone / email / text); retail close and open pipeline. Source mix lives on the Leads tab.

Pertinent handling numbers

Date range: Jun 26 – Sep 23, 2026 (vs prior 90 days Mar 28 – Jun 25, 2026)
What this section is Handling grades for rolling 90 on unique opportunities after de-dupe. Bad CRM leads are excluded. Contact and speed grades appear only when the CRM export includes attempt fields.
Handling color legend
GoodKPI is in the healthy band for that metric
WatchKPI is middling — keep an eye on it
ProblemKPI is below the store target band
Per-card rulesInternet contact ≥90% good / <75% problem · response goal ≤15 min (after 15 = not good; ≥25% over 30 = problem even if median looks ok) · retail close ≥8% good / <5% problem · untouched 0 good

What this means Of internet unique opportunities (de-duped, excluding Bad), how many show a real work attempt — first contact attempt, phone/email/text, customer contact, or CRM contacted flag? Phone-ups and walk-ins are not in this grade — those are almost always “contacted” by nature and inflate the number. Higher is better. About 90%+ is good. Under 75% is a problem.

Speed problem — missed goal: 192 timed internet leads (30.7%) took over 30 minutes. Store goal is first response in ≤15 minutes. 267 (42.7%) were after 15 min — that is not good. Do not let the median hide this bucket.
What this means Internet only, using VinSolutions adjusted response time when the export includes it. Phone-ups and walk-ins are not mixed in — they often show as 0 minutes and fake a fast store. Goal is ≤15 minutes. Any first response after 15 min is not good. The red over 30 min bucket is the problem list — read it even when the median looks okay. Bands: ≤15 on goal · 16–30 late · over 30 missed goal.

Date ranges on this page
Rolling 90: Jun 26 – Sep 23, 2026.
Prior 90 days: Mar 28 – Jun 25, 2026.
Organized as a sales funnel: website traffic → inventory health (active lot) → demand shape (VOI / trades) → CRM opportunities (site + 3rd party → internet/phone/walk-in) → handling quality (including how the team tries to reach customers) → salesperson execution. Unique opportunities after de-dupe (VIN/stock within 7 days, or same salesperson + day + vehicle). Internet + phone + walk-in on the same shopper counts as one. Headline contact rate is internet leads only (workable, de-duped, any real attempt). Internet speed uses CRM adjusted response time on internet leads only. Inventory panel uses VinSolutions live-lot units when an inventory export is present. Lead data: VinSolutions. Website traffic (GA4 cache 2026-09-18 · GA4 2026-06-20 → 2026-09-17): 54,837 visits · 48,730 people. Generated Sep 24, 2026 11:21 AM. This page is for Audi Baton Rouge only — no other stores.
Data coverage — Lead export only covers Jun 23 – Sep 21, 2026. This window is partial (effective Sep 1–21, 2026). Closed-deal (DMS) history may still be complete.
Month to date at a glance
Month to date: 194 retail workable opportunities (386 unique after de-dupe; Bad excluded; 150 wholesale/acquisition set aside); retail close 7.7% (15 retail sold); internet is 82.5% of retail workable; internet CRM contact 99.4%; internet median response 6 min; 15.9% of timed internet leads over 30 min (missed goal); 1 workable leads still untouched over 24h; 151 KBB ICO / acquisition leads (cash offer on their car — not retail opps); Audi Partner is 56 opps at 3.6% close — watch list.

Stage 4 · Lead handling quality
How well are we taking care of the leads?
Speed and contact coverage when the CRM export includes them; how the team tries to reach customers (phone / email / text); retail close and open pipeline. Source mix lives on the Leads tab.

What this means Of internet unique opportunities (de-duped, excluding Bad), how many show a real work attempt — first contact attempt, phone/email/text, customer contact, or CRM contacted flag? Phone-ups and walk-ins are not in this grade — those are almost always “contacted” by nature and inflate the number. Higher is better. About 90%+ is good. Under 75% is a problem.

Store goal: first internet response in ≤15 minutes. After 15 min = not good. Over 30 min = missed goal.
≤15 min · on goal105 (72.4%)

Speed problem — missed goal: 23 timed internet leads (15.9%) took over 30 minutes. Store goal is first response in ≤15 minutes. 40 (27.6%) were after 15 min — that is not good. Do not let the median hide this bucket.
What this means Internet only, using VinSolutions adjusted response time when the export includes it. Phone-ups and walk-ins are not mixed in — they often show as 0 minutes and fake a fast store. Goal is ≤15 minutes. Any first response after 15 min is not good. The red over 30 min bucket is the problem list — read it even when the median looks okay. Bands: ≤15 on goal · 16–30 late · over 30 missed goal.

Organized as a sales funnel: website traffic → inventory health (active lot) → demand shape (VOI / trades) → CRM opportunities (site + 3rd party → internet/phone/walk-in) → handling quality (including how the team tries to reach customers) → salesperson execution. Unique opportunities after de-dupe (VIN/stock within 7 days, or same salesperson + day + vehicle). Internet + phone + walk-in on the same shopper counts as one. Headline contact rate is internet leads only (workable, de-duped, any real attempt). Internet speed uses CRM adjusted response time on internet leads only. Inventory panel uses VinSolutions live-lot units when an inventory export is present. Lead data: VinSolutions.
